Package com.egradx.notification.delivery

Class EgradxDeliveryService

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.notification.delivery.EgradxDeliveryService
public class EgradxDeliveryService extends Object
Reading the delivery log, and bringing DEAD deliveries back.

An in-process API with no access control of its own, like egradx-auth's services: whatever exposes it — an admin endpoint, an operations script — decides who may call it. The REST surface for it arrives with the admin phase.
